result.reason: The redline reaches at least the fallback and most of the preferred scope: Affiliates and contractors receive direct rights, their access is expressly carved out from the third-party-access restriction, Customer remains accountable for them, and the licence transfers with assignments permitted under Section (h), including M&A successors. The changes are targeted and preserve the platform-use restrictions and allocation of responsibility. It does not clearly achieve the preferred duration position, however, because termination under Section 4 is not expressly limited to uncured material breach, and no perpetual/irrevocable treatment is provided for any paid-up licence. Drafting quality is reduced by the awkward construction “license, revocable only” and reliance on an unseen termination provision, but the operative language still satisfies the stated fallback.
